items.stem: A free app requests access to contacts, location, microphone and SMS but only shows a flashlight. What is the best conclusion?

options.text: The permissions are excessive for its function and the app is suspicious
options.rationale: Correct: permissions far beyond the stated function are a red flag.

options.text: The permissions are normal for any app
options.rationale: A flashlight needs none of those permissions.

options.text: More permissions always mean a better app
options.rationale: Excess permissions increase risk, not quality.

options.text: Permissions have nothing to do with security
options.rationale: Permissions directly affect what data an app can reach.

items.explanation: Correct: permissions far beyond the app's function are a warning sign.

items.stem: Which TWO controls best protect data on a lost work phone? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Full-device encryption with a strong passcode
options.rationale: Correct: encryption plus a strong passcode protects data at rest.

options.text: The ability to remotely wipe the device
options.rationale: Correct: remote wipe removes data if recovery fails.

options.text: A four-digit PIN reused as the user's bank PIN
options.rationale: A weak, reused PIN offers little protection.

options.text: Disabling all updates to save battery
options.rationale: Disabling updates leaves known vulnerabilities open.

items.explanation: Correct: encryption with a strong passcode and remote wipe both protect lost-device data.

items.stem: In a BYOD programme, what is the main reason to separate work and personal data on a device?

options.text: It lets the company protect work data without controlling personal information
options.rationale: Correct: containerisation respects privacy while securing work data.

options.text: It makes the phone run faster
options.rationale: Separation is about data governance, not speed.

options.text: It removes the need for any passcode
It gives the company full control of personal photos
options.rationale: The point is to avoid, not enable, reaching personal data.

items.explanation: Correct: separation secures work data while leaving personal data private.
